name: THE PATRONS
note: One card player, as his own sprite with his own beat. The bodies in this sheet are PIXEL-LOCKED -- whole-figure difference of 1.1, 2.7 and 1.3 between poses against 8 to 18 before -- which is what made cutting the men apart possible at all: each sprite changes in exactly ONE pose and is byte-identical, 0.0, in the other two. The far-left man turns his head right.

sprite.note: A BEAT, not a loop: at rest, and every few seconds the movement plays once. Different intervals per man so they coincide only by chance.
